fee_notes: License Fee (royalty) up to 8% of Gross Sales with minimum fees (not detailed in excerpt). Out-of-territory fee 15%. MAP Fund 2% of Gross Sales. Local Marketing Groups up to 3%. Software System $186.95/month base includes Qvinci, FranConnect, Customer Engagement Platform, Neighborly Franchise Portal, Office365 (2 email accounts), RingCentral (1 line). Additional optional fees: extra email accounts $5.50-$30/month, extra RingCentral $29/month, extra portal users $20-$40/month, QuickBooks Online $30-$220/month, Business Management Software (Real Green) $379/month + $125/hour support, Call Center $349.99-$449.99/month + $25 per appointment, HelpDesk $200-$400/month, training up to $600/day, conventions $250/day or $1,000 annual. Late fees $25/month, interest 12% on unpaid balances.
raw_excerpt: License Fee up to 8% of Gross Sales. In addition, minimum license fees apply. MAP Fee 2% of Gross Sales. Local Marketing Groups Not to exceed 3% of Gross Sales. Software System Fees Currently $186.95 per month plus additional optional services.
